title: Dungeons
landing_text: The procedural Demon Dungeon system is real on this branch again: performing the Ritual of the Vault opens a generated dungeon in its own dimension, room by room, gated by keyed doors. Some 1.20.1 flavor content (Tau Fruit farming, Spatial Distortions, the Inversion Pillar portal blocks, the separate Mines sub-area) hasn't been carried over yet - see Exploring the Dungeon for what's actually here.
